playArea.grid: Same grid as heightmap.png: pixel (col, row) is centered on heightmap vertex (col, row), i.e. x = (col - 800) * 5, z = (row - 800) * 5. Row 0 = -z (north), column 0 = -x (west). The image covers x, z in [-4002.5, 4002.5] m.
playArea.uv: u = (x + 4002.5) / 8005, v_down = (z + 4002.5) / 8005 (v_down = 0 at the top row). With a PlaneGeometry spanning the play area the error is at most half a texel.
playArea.values: linear_albedo = srgb_to_linear(value / 255). Mean = 0.222 (value 130). Grayscale: tint it in the shader. To use it as a multiplier on a base color, divide the decoded value by 0.222.

source.dataset: Generated (seed 2035). Look matched to Cassini ISS near-IR, VIMS and RADAR views of the Shangri-La dunes (dark dunes, bright interdunes, bright rough Selk ejecta) and to the Huygens DISR surface images (rounded cobbles)
source.citation: Lorenz, R.D., et al. (2006), Science 312, 724-727; Radebaugh, J., et al. (2008), Icarus 194, 690-703; Barnes, J.W., et al. (2008), Icarus 195, 400-414 (VIMS dune spectra); Lorenz, R.D., et al. (2021), Planet. Sci. J. 2:24; Tomasko, M.G., et al. (2005), Nature 438, 765-778
source.credit: Modeled on Cassini and Huygens data (NASA/JPL-Caltech/ASI/ESA/University of Arizona)

processing: Units from build_terrain_titan.py: dune cores (dark, 0.11), sand skirts within 250 m of a dune (0.2), interdune flats (0.29, with 300 m patchiness and faint west-east wind streaks), Selk ejecta (0.3, mottled, with bright blocks densest in the ejecta field), the bright interdune sample patch (0.38).
Huygens-like pebbles: speckle fading out over 350 m around the landing (the real cobbles are centimeters, far below a 5 m texel).
No baked shading: the renderer lights the heightmap.
limits: Modeled, not imaged: no image of Titan resolves the ground at this scale. Only the pattern (dark dunes, bright interdunes and ejecta) follows Cassini; brightness values are game choices.
